about_the_game:
CarX Drift Racing Online - New Style: This is a new design line for your favorite cars in completely different styles from the Studio CX. It includes 3 new vinyl for popular cars among which you will find what you like.
The composition of DLC - New Style includes:
  • Pirate - Revival
  • Falcon RZ - Chameleon
  • Piranha X - Fury
